places.name: Logar Valley Landscape Park
places.ai_summary: A stunning glacial valley known for its pristine nature, hiking trails, and breathtaking views of the Alps.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in spring or autumn.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning scenery.

places.name: Rinka Waterfall
places.ai_summary: A majestic waterfall located at the end of Logar Valley, accessible via a short hike.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for fewer crowds.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes for the hike to the waterfall.

places.ai_summary: A scenic drive offering breathtaking views of the Solčava region, including the Savinja River and surrounding mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Drive carefully, especially in winter conditions.

places.place_tip: Stop at the viewpoints along the road for the best photos.
